summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Heirloom Demo Experience feature. All 11 features requested are working correctly. Demo showcases Sharma-Williams family with 3 generations and 10 memories, Sage AI companion, cinematic memory viewer, PDF export, and voice narration.
passed_tests: Landing page loads with Demo button visible in navigation
Sage welcome modal appears after 3 seconds for first-time visitors
Demo page at /demo loads and shows Sharma-Williams family
Family Tree tab shows 3 generations of family members (6 members total)
Memory Gallery tab shows all 10 memories with cover images
Clicking a memory opens cinematic detail view with background image
Cinematic view has prev/next/play/pause controls and timeline
Life Book tab shows PDF preview with download button
PDF download generates and downloads successfully (Sharma-Williams_Family_Stories.pdf)
Sage narrations appear on different views with context-aware messages
Voice toggle works (both header and Sage bubble)
Navigation between demo views works (Introduction, Family Tree, Memory Gallery, Life Book)
Family member selection shows detail with 'View Stories' button
Autoplay functionality in cinematic viewer works
Sage floating button appears after closing bubble
critical_code_review_comments: Minor ESLint warning in SageCompanion.jsx line 232: synthRef.current should be copied to variable in effect for proper cleanup - non-blocking, functionality unaffected
seed_data_creation: Demo uses static data from /app/frontend/src/data/demoFamily.js - no seed data needed

The demo showcases the app with Sharma-Williams family (6 members, 3 generations, 10 memories). Voice narration uses Web Speech API. PDF export uses jsPDF library.
